cards.text:
V-TD12/001EN
Ranunculus Flower Maiden, Ahsha
Normal Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], call up to two Plant tokens to (RC), and this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn. (Plants are grade 0/[Power] 5000/[Critical] 1 and have boost)
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Retire three rear-guards], and call an Ahsha's Flower Fairy token to (RC). (Ahsha's Flower Fairies are grade 0 and have an ability to become Ahsha)
